mapper.sql: l.id,l.operator,l.operator_id,l.action,l.target_type,l.target_id,l.target_name,l.description, l.ip,l.user_agent,l.status,l.error_message,l.created_at, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(l.created_at)*1000 AS SIGNED) AS created_at_epoch_ms, u.username AS current_operator, CASE WHEN l.operator_id IS NULL THEN 'unverified' WHEN u.id IS NULL OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'deleted' WHEN u.status != 1 THEN 'disabled' WHEN u.role = 'admin' THEN 'admin' ELSE 'user' END AS operator_account_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(l.status=1),0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(l.status=0),0) AS failure, COALESCE(SUM(l.created_at >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{todayStart}) AND l.created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{todayEnd})),0) AS today FROM system_logs l

SELECT action,COUNT(*) AS count FROM system_logs GROUP BY action ORDER BY count DESC
